title: Wilted Shattering Uruguayan Onions Empanadas
description: This winey, shattering, nostalgic Uruguay dish is made with red onions, long-fermentation dough, and is low in fat.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the egg and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Mix the red onions, garlic, and red wine vinegar in a bowl.
Place a tablespoon of the onion mixture onto one half of each circle.
Fold the other half over the onion mixture and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Cook the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown.
Brush the tops with butter and cook for an additional minute.
Wilt the onions with a tablespoon of red wine vinegar for 2-3 minutes, or until they are soft and caramelized.
